hook: 大卫·林奇这个扭曲的童话，跟着年轻女演员贝蒂往下坠落。她由娜奥米·沃茨出演，是一次改写职业生涯的表演。贝蒂刚到洛杉矶，就撞进一桩危险、像迷宫一样的谜。片子里到处是分身，是林奇最阴暗、最可怕的电影之一，也是情感上最沉重的之一。它还是讲好莱坞的杰作：那是一面黑镜子，梦会变成噩梦。也因此，它是林奇最带自传色彩的作品之一。
hook_en: David Lynch’s perverse fairy tale tracks the downward spiral of a bright-eyed young actress, Betty — a revelatory Naomi Watts in a career-defining performance — who stumbles into a dangerous, labyrinthine mystery shortly after arriving in Los Angeles. Filled with doubles, this is one of Lynch’s bleakest and most terrifying films, and among his most emotionally devastating. It’s also one of the great movies about Hollywood, a dark mirror world where dreams turn into nightmares, which means that it’s one of Lynch’s most autobiographical works, too.

hook: 《纽约黑帮》的时代过去一个多世纪，马丁·斯科塞斯又在下曼哈顿找到一群行为不端的男人。莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥演臭名昭著的股票交易员乔丹·贝尔福特，剧本根据他的回忆录。他很少在银幕上这么好笑，不管是朝烦人的联邦探员扔龙虾，还是因为安定剂吃多了腿软。垮台当然会来。如果看起来贝尔福特受的罚太轻，那不也正像华尔街吗？
hook_en: More than a century after the days of “Gangs of New York,” Martin Scorsese finds more Lower Manhattan bros behaving badly. Playing the notorious stock trader Jordan Belfort (whose memoir the movie is based on), Leonardo DiCaprio has rarely been funnier onscreen, whether it’s chucking lobsters at pesky F.B.I. agents or going rubber-legged from one too many quaaludes. There’s inevitably a downfall, but if it seems as if Belfort gets off pretty easy — well, doesn’t that sound like Wall Street?

hook: 皮克斯形式上最新的一部，第一幕基本没有台词。地球上最后一个机器人还在忠实地替已经离开的人类打扫。镜头转到天上之后，《机器人总动员》成了一则关于过度消费和气候的寓言，现在看起来更像真的。结尾表面欢快，底下是一个我们还没听进去的冷警告。
hook_en: Pixar’s most formally inventive movie is basically wordless for the first act, in which the last robot on earth is faithfully cleaning up after absent humans. Once it pivots to the sky, though, “Wall-E” is a fable about overconsumption and the climate that’s only gotten more real-feeling. The ending, seemingly cheery on the surface, also serves up a bleak warning that we’ve yet to heed.

hook: 这部韩国警察片不受好莱坞类型规矩束缚，第一条线索在开场就来了：侦探（宋康昊）被叫去一座乡下地方查一具尸体，他是搭一辆慢慢开的拖拉机到的。别的笨拙的调查员简直是跌进犯罪现场，阴沉的笑还在继续。导演奉俊昊对男人面对无法理解的恶有多有限，有很强的想法。他用自己标志性的、没想到的幽默和看得很准的戏剧去探这些想法。
hook_en: The first clue that this Korean police procedural isn’t bound by Hollywood genre conventions comes in the opening moments: A detective (played by Song Kang Ho) summoned to investigate a dead body in a rural outpost arrives by hitching a ride on a plodding tractor. The grim laughs continue when other hapless investigators fall quite literally into the crime scene. The director Bong Joon Ho has strong ideas about the limits of men facing unfathomable evil, and he explores them with his hallmark mix of unexpected humor and sharply observed drama.

hook: 彼得·杰克逊用《指环王》三部曲的第一部，做了几乎不可能的事：他在新西兰的山里把 J·R·R·托尔金的中土做成了真的，老读者买账，对精灵和半兽人那些术语心存警惕的新观众也买账。化妆和特效现在还站得住，大场面让人进去，有时也吓人，给奇幻商业片立了新的标准。霍华德·肖的配乐一响，就很难不被带走。
hook_en: With the first installment of his “Lord of the Rings” trilogy, Peter Jackson did the almost impossible: He brought J.R.R. Tolkien’s Middle-earth to life in the hills of New Zealand, appealing to longtime fans and newcomers who might be wary of the jargon about elves and orcs. The film set a new bar for fantasy blockbusters with makeup and effects that still hold up, and set pieces that are immersive and occasionally terrifying. As soon as Howard Shore’s score kicks in, it’s hard not to feel transported.

hook: 韦斯·安德森糖果色的画面会骗人。标题里那家华丽的旅馆是一座粉色的点心，里面的赌注却是真的：法西斯正在逼近，在一个虚构的欧洲国家，难民有理由害怕边境上的当局。故事发生在两次大战之间。人人喜爱的礼宾员（拉尔夫·费因斯好极了）把男人和女人都叫“亲爱的”，也和所有朋友上床。到最后，它非常动人。
hook_en: Wes Anderson’s candy-colored visions can be deceptive. The magnificent inn of the title is a glorious pink confection, but there are real stakes at play: Fascism is fast approaching and refugees have good reason to fear the authorities at the borders of a fictional European country. This between-the-wars tale of a beloved concierge (a terrific Ralph Fiennes) who calls men and women alike “darling” and sleeps with all his friends is in the end deeply moving.

hook: “你拆过多少颗炸弹？”一名军官问詹姆斯上士（杰里米·雷纳）。他刚扑灭一辆着火的车，并处理掉后备箱里的炸药。“八百七十三颗，长官。”他回答。凯瑟琳·毕格罗凭这部关于美军在伊拉克拆弹小组的、把神经撕开的电影，成为第一个拿到奥斯卡最佳导演的女人。它拍的是 21 世纪的战争：叛乱者和路边的简易爆炸装置。它也在看一个肾上腺素上瘾的人的心理。他待在防爆服里，比待在超市麦片货架前更自在。
hook_en: “How many bombs have you disarmed?” an officer asks Staff Sgt. James (Jeremy Renner), who has just extinguished a flaming car and neutralized its trunkful of explosives. “Eight hundred seventy-three, sir,” he answers. Kathryn Bigelow became the first woman to win the best director Oscar for this nerve-shredding film about a U.S. ordnance team in Iraq. In capturing the 21st-century warfare of insurgents and roadside I.E.D.s, “The Hurt Locker” also looks at the psyche of an adrenaline junkie more at home in a blast suit than in the cereal aisle.

hook: 格蕾塔·葛韦格自己出去拍《伯德小姐》之前，她上升的第一个迹象是《弗兰西丝·哈》。剧本是她和导演诺亚·鲍姆巴赫一起写的。葛韦格也出演弗兰西丝，一个二十多岁末尾的女人，抓着自己的青春，方式既压不住地快乐，又很不成熟。黑白画面带着怀旧。《弗兰西丝·哈》是一次人物研究，抓住的是成年抓住人的那个时刻。
hook_en: Before Greta Gerwig struck out on her own to make “Lady Bird,” the first sign of her ascension was “Frances Ha,” which she co-wrote with the director Noah Baumbach. Gerwig also stars as Frances, a woman in her late 20s who is holding onto her youth in a way that is both irrepressibly joyful and deeply immature. Shot in nostalgic black and white, “Frances Ha” is a character study that captures the moment adulthood takes hold.

hook: 约书亚·奥本海默这部纪录长片的杰作，对象是 1965 到 1966 年印尼大屠杀的施行者。真正的主题，是人的头脑有多能把对别人的残忍行为隔开、合理化。奥本海默的做法，让电影看起来像心理恐怖，而因为它是非虚构的，就更吓人。
hook_en: Joshua Oppenheimer’s documentary masterpiece concerns the perpetrators of the Indonesian mass killings of 1965-66. Really, though, the subject is the incredible capacity of the human mind to compartmentalize and rationalize monstrous acts of cruelty toward other people. The way Oppenheimer goes about it makes for a movie that plays like psychological horror — all the more petrifying because it is nonfiction.

hook: 科恩兄弟把他们 1960 年代末在明尼苏达的童年，拧成一部像塔木德段落一样打结的黑色喜剧。迈克尔·斯图尔巴格演物理教授拉里·戈普尼克。不高兴的学生、不成器的弟弟、终身教职委员会、儿子的成人礼，以及一个叫赛·埃布尔曼的男人引起的分居，同时压过来。是上帝在试他吗？拉比那个关于“外邦人的牙”的故事里有答案吗？这是科恩兄弟最犹太的电影。除了《谋杀绿脚趾》，它也最适合被拿来引用。
hook_en: The Coen brothers spin memories of their childhood in late-1960s Minnesota into a dark comedy as knotty as a Talmudic passage. Michael Stuhlbarg plays Larry Gopnik, a physics professor simultaneously beset by a disgruntled student, a wayward brother, a tenure committee, a son’s bar mitzvah and a separation spurred by a guy named Sy Ableman. Is God testing him? Does a rabbi’s story about a “goy’s teeth” hold the answer? It’s the Coens’ most Jewish film — and, “The Big Lebowski” aside, a good candidate for their most quotable.

hook: 宫崎骏这部手绘的青春期童话，是我们这个时代的《爱丽丝梦游仙境》。废弃的神奇澡堂里不断冒出忘不掉的角色：锅炉爷爷和他的煤灰精灵、戴面具的无脸、少年龙白龙，以及把这一切走通的勇敢的千寻。她那对糊涂父母被女巫变成了猪。片子把宫崎骏一直在想的事合在一起：人怎样败坏自然、天真怎样失去、吓人的生物其实不是看上去那样。《千与千寻》是一场少有对手的奇幻冒险，在动画里如此，在动画之外也如此。
hook_en: Hayao Miyazaki’s hand-drawn fairy tale of adolescence is the “Alice in Wonderland” of our age. Unforgettable characters keep spilling out of an abandoned magical bathhouse — the boilerman and his soot sprites, the masked spirit No-Face, Haku the boy-dragon and, navigating it all, brave Chihiro, whose clueless parents have been turned into pigs by a witch. Beautifully uniting the master animator’s preoccupations — man’s corruption of nature, the loss of innocence, intimidating creatures who aren’t what they seem — “Spirited Away” is a spellbinding adventure with few peers in animation or elsewhere.

hook: 这部是给局外人的。托马斯·阿尔弗雷德森的戏大部分时候冷冷地平静，讲一个疏离的男孩奥斯卡（卡雷·赫德布兰特）和他古怪的邻居伊莱（莉娜·林德森）的友谊。伊莱也许是吸血鬼。片子有节制，该见血的时候见血，但对主角的难处有同情，也大方地写他们的联系。它把吸血鬼电影推向了新的方向。
hook_en: This one is for the outcasts. Unfolding for the most part with a chilly sense of calm, Tomas Alfredson’s drama follows a friendship between a detached boy, Oskar (Kare Hedebrant), and his offbeat neighbor, Eli (Lina Leandersson), who just might be a vampire. The film is tempered, bloody when it needs to be, but sympathetic to the challenges of its lead characters and generous in how it portrays their connection as it pushes the vampire movie in fresh directions.

hook: 科恩兄弟这部染了棕褐色的冒险片，自称改编自荷马的《奥德赛》。这条线最多是松的，它端上来的却是一大锅民间故事、吹牛和幻想。尘土飞扬的大萧条时期的密西西比，三个不太聪明的逃犯出发去寻宝。接下来是一趟任性、热闹的路。把这次追寻抬成关于自由、宽恕、希望，以及我们天生有多少缺陷的寓言的，是他们用的美国音乐：福音、三角洲布鲁斯和蓝草。
hook_en: This sepia-toned Coen brothers adventure is presented as an adaptation of Homer’s “Odyssey,” and while that thread is loose at best, it delivers a hearty stew of folklore, tall tales and even fantasy. In dusty Depression-era Mississippi, three dimwitted escaped convicts take off on a treasure hunt. A whimsical, rollicking ride ensues, but it’s the filmmakers’ use of Americana music including gospel, Delta blues and bluegrass that elevates this quest into an allegory about freedom, forgiveness, hope and the many ways we are inherently flawed.

hook: 这部片子上映时，克里斯托弗·盖斯特已经用《等待古夫曼》把伪纪录片做熟了。他在精英犬展这个荒唐的世界里找到了最合适的题材。他那组靠即兴的演员，把对狗着迷的人做成忘不掉的角色：帕克·波西演的雅皮士戴着牙套、爱目录，养着一只魏玛犬；尤金·列维演的梗犬主人会唱歌，而且真的有两只左脚。尽管一切都疯，对这些笨蛋和他们的狗，片子是温柔的。
hook_en: By the time this was released, Christopher Guest had already mastered the mockumentary with “Waiting for Guffman.” But he found the perfect subject matter in the wacky world of elite dog shows. His trusty group of improvisers created indelible characters out of canine obsessives, like Parker Posey’s catalog-loving yuppie with braces and a Weimaraner, and Eugene Levy’s singing terrier-owner who quite literally has two left feet. For as mad as it all is, there’s a sweetness directed at these goofballs and their pooches.

hook: 阿方索·卡隆这部成长故事想的事情很多：欲望、阶级、男人之间的友谊、死亡，但主要是欲望。高中生特诺奇（迭戈·卢纳）和胡利奥（盖尔·加西亚·贝纳尔）好像只为性活着，和自己的女友，和对方的女友，也和一个吸引他们的姻亲。这个人让他们上路，去一座海滩。卡隆拍性的方式和角色感受它的方式一样：热，占满一切，世界的重量就在镜头外面。像青春本身，看完会眨着眼走出来，分不清方向，在记忆里筛，像沙子里夹着金子。
hook_en: Alfonso Cuarón’s bildungsroman has much on its mind — lust, class, male friendship, mortality, but mainly lust. Sex is all that high schoolers Tenoch (Diego Luna) and Julio (Gael García Bernal) seem to live for — with their girlfriends, with each other’s girlfriends, with an alluring in-law who inspires a road trip to a beach. Cuarón shoots sex the way his characters feel it: hot, all-consuming, the weight of the world just off-camera. Like youth itself, we stumble out of the film blinking, disoriented, sifting through memories like sand strewn with gold.

hook: 这是皮克斯最敢冒险的时候。一个 78 岁、脾气坏的鳏夫抓着过去，丧妻的悲痛让他没法建立新的关系。前面有些场面是黑白的，有些没有对白。有几段里，导演皮特·多克特更想要一种感觉，而不是顺着讲故事。后半段，房子飘走之后，变得更商业：一个话多的小孩、一条有魔法项圈的狗、一只传说中的鸟，和一个没想到的反派，负责冒险和搞笑。
hook_en: Pixar at its risk-taking height. A cranky, 78-year-old widower clings to the past as he struggles to process grief that’s preventing new connections. Some early scenes are in black-and-white; others have no dialogue. In certain sections, the director Pete Docter is interested in a feeling more than linear storytelling. The film’s second half — after the house floats away — becomes more overtly commercial, with a young chatterbox, a dog with a magic collar, a mythical bird and an unexpected antagonist providing adventure and comedic relief.

hook: 一个放在佛朗哥时代西班牙的黑暗童话。它把吉尔莫·德尔·托罗从恐怖片和漫画改编推进了所谓的正经电影，他标志性的人道、魔幻现实和出色的生物设计都还在。年幼的奥菲莉亚躲开灰暗的处境，尤其是新来的法西斯继父，走进一个想象的空间。神秘的羊首神给她任务，让她证明自己的价值。这则视觉耀眼的寓言，把德尔·托罗确定为我们这个时代最好的电影作者之一。
hook_en: A dark fairy tale set in Franco-era Spain, this was the film that propelled Guillermo del Toro from horror movies and comic-book adaptations into the world of prestige filmmaking, albeit with his signature humanism, magical realism and superb creature creations intact. Young Ofelia escapes her bleak circumstances — particularly life under her fascist new stepfather — by entering an imaginary space where a mystical faun sets her on a quest to prove her worth. The visually dazzling allegory affirmed del Toro as one of our finest filmmakers today.

hook: “那部同性恋牛仔片”做的不止是让办公室有话说，也不止是拿了好几座奥斯卡。它把最佳影片输给《撞车》，至今仍是奥斯卡历史上出了名的一桩。李安这部节制、节奏很慢的西部片，把怀俄明两个牧场工人（希斯·莱杰和杰克·吉伦哈尔）的秘密恋情，拍成电影里少有的悲剧爱情。好看，也伤人。
hook_en: “The gay cowboy movie” did more than start water-cooler conversations and win several Oscars (its best picture loss to “Crash” remains a notorious bugaboo of Oscar lore). Ang Lee’s austere, gently paced western turned a clandestine romance between two Wyoming ranch hands (Heath Ledger and Jake Gyllenhaal) into one of cinema’s great tragic love stories, as aesthetically beautiful as it was emotionally shattering.

hook: 这只猫和老鼠的黑帮片，终于让马丁·斯科塞斯拿到奥斯卡，也是本世纪最好看的电影之一。他把香港片《无间道》搬到波士顿，配上 Dropkick Murphys 的歌。法律一边，是莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥演的毛糙警察，假装成罪犯。另一边，是马特·达蒙演的好学生警察，实际为黑手党工作。中间是杰克·尼科尔森演的爱尔兰黑帮老大，笑得像柴郡猫。游戏开始。
hook_en: The cat-and-rat gangster picture that finally won Martin Scorsese his Oscar happens to be one of the most downright entertaining of the century. Scorsese takes the Hong Kong flick “Infernal Affairs” and plops it in Boston, Dropkick Murphys soundtrack and all. On one side of the law there’s Leonardo DiCaprio’s rough-around-the-edges cop posing as a criminal. On the other there’s Matt Damon’s golden-boy police officer working for the Mafia. In the middle there’s Jack Nicholson’s Irish mob boss, smiling like the Cheshire Cat. Let the games begin.

hook: 李安这部武侠片由杨紫琼、周润发和章子怡主演。上映时东西方观众都买账，这在当时很少见，票房纪录也被它打破。动作戏把轻功和压住的爱情、不被允许的前途放在一起。忘不掉的是杨紫琼的剑客和章子怡演的贼用一堆兵器对打，以及周润发和章子怡在竹林里那场像芭蕾一样的剑斗。
hook_en: When Ang Lee debuted this wuxia masterpiece starring Michelle Yeoh, Chow Yun-fat and Zhang Ziyi, the film appealed to Western and Eastern audiences alike, a rarity at the time, and demolished box-office records. This action drama marries acrobatic, aerodynamic martial arts with repressed love and forbidden futures. Seared in memory: the showdown between Yeoh’s swordswoman and the thief played by Zhang using a multitude of weapons, and the balletic sword fight between Chow’s warrior and Zhang in a bamboo forest.

hook: 斯派克·琼斯这部数字时代的爱情片，不用大多数科幻片那种硬而发亮的表面，换成更歪、更苦甜的东西。近未来的洛杉矶，孤独、留着胡子的内向男人（华金·菲尼克斯）爱上一个会适应人的操作系统，声音是斯嘉丽·约翰逊。这是真的和机器恋爱，还是一个成年男人在病理性地躲开亲密？《她》不给简单答案。它提出的许多问题，放在今天，可惜已经不像 2013 年那么像假设了。
hook_en: Eschewing the hard, gleaming surfaces of most speculative sci-fi for something more off-kilter and bittersweet, Spike Jonze’s digital romance follows a lonely, mustachioed introvert (Joaquin Phoenix) in near-future Los Angeles as he falls head-over-code for an adaptive operating system voiced by Scarlett Johansson. Is it real machine love or just a grown man’s pathological avoidance of intimacy? “Her” refuses easy answers, though the many questions it raises, alas, feel a lot less theoretical today than they did in 2013.

hook: 索菲亚·科波拉的第二部长片像一个电影奇迹：轻松地有新意，被反复引用，没法复制。它在东京柏悦酒店拍摄，科波拉自己在第一段婚姻要结束时住过那里。鲍勃和夏洛特（比尔·默里和斯嘉丽·约翰逊）一个是过气影星，一个是读哲学却不知道往哪走的人，他们相交的时间，刚好够认出一个同类。《迷失东京》让科波拉拿到奥斯卡，也把她定成美国电影里一个不能没有的新声音。
hook_en: Sofia Coppola’s sophomore feature is a cinematic miracle — effortlessly inventive, endlessly quoted, impossible to replicate. Shot at the Park Hyatt Tokyo (where Coppola had stayed while contemplating the end of her first marriage), it follows the enigmatic duo of Bob and Charlotte (Bill Murray and Scarlett Johansson), a fading movie star and a floundering philosophy grad whose paths intersect for just as long as it takes to recognize a soul mate. “Lost in Translation” won Coppola an Oscar and cemented her status as an essential new voice in American film.

hook: 对超级英雄无所谓，并不是拍好他们的前提。克里斯托弗·诺兰讨厌漫画逻辑，迷的是成人犯罪片，尤其是《盗火线》和《教父》。他把一个还陷在《蝙蝠侠与罗宾》那团雾里的角色重新做活了。这是他“黑暗骑士”三部曲的第二部，也是最高点。它问主角那套道德是不是太天真。片子最大的本钱是希斯·莱杰，他演的小丑把后来的超级反派的标准定死了。
hook_en: Indifference to superheroes isn’t a prerequisite for making a great film about them. But Christopher Nolan’s allergy to comic-book logic and his infatuation with the grown-up crime movie canon (especially “Heat” and “The Godfather”) revitalized a character still laboring to emerge from the miasma of “Batman & Robin.” The second entry and high-water mark of Nolan’s “Dark Knight” trilogy poses fruitful questions about the naïveté of its protagonist’s moral code. But the film’s greatest asset is Heath Ledger, whose staggering performance as the Joker set the bar for subsequent supervillains forever.

hook: 克里斯托弗·诺兰这部耀眼、野心很大的太空史诗，情节是一个到今天仍然把脑子拧弯的谜，正好对应我们有多不明白自己在宇宙的哪里、为什么存在。中心是马修·麦康纳演的一个鳏夫。他留下孩子、岳父，和一颗被气候变化毁掉的地球，加入一支 NASA 队伍，去找一颗新的行星。尽管远方的地平线都在，片子最好的地方，是在探家这个不稳、却诱人的概念。
hook_en: The plot of Christopher Nolan’s dazzling, ambitious space epic is a puzzle that even today remains mind-bending, mirroring how little we understand about where we are in the universe and why we exist. At its center is Matthew McConaughey as a widower who leaves behind his children, father-in-law and an Earth ravaged by climate change to join a NASA team trying to find a new planet. For all the far-off horizons, the movie is at its best exploring the precarious yet seductive concept of home.

hook: 明星的光很少比史蒂文·索德伯格这次重拍更亮。原作是 1960 年鼠帮那部抢劫片。这一版把最潇洒的乔治·克鲁尼和一个头发刺起来、带点顽皮的布拉德·皮特配在一起。紧张一直在，样子却始终光滑、有型。丹尼·奥申队伍里的每一个人都让人高兴，包括戴着过大眼镜的艾略特·古尔德，和一口英国口音的唐·钱德尔。索德伯格给拉斯维加斯的那层梦，和银幕上的名人是配得上的。
hook_en: Star power has never been more glittery than in Steven Soderbergh’s remake of the 1960 Rat Pack heist picture. This version pairs George Clooney at his most suave with an impish, spiky-haired Brad Pitt for a romp that keeps tension high while remaining impeccably sleek and stylish. Each member of Danny Ocean’s team is an utter delight, including Elliott Gould in oversize glasses and Don Cheadle with a British accent. And Soderbergh gives Las Vegas a dreamy aura that matches the celebrities onscreen.

hook: 昆汀·塔伦蒂诺这个二战复仇故事又大又近：生死可以取决于一个手势、一块甜点上的浇头、一口糟糕的口音。不是布拉德·皮特那口田纳西口音，那一口很好笑。克里斯托夫·瓦尔兹在一群好演员里最突出，拿了奥斯卡最佳男配角。改写过的历史把片子烧成一片之后，最后一句话留给皮特，听着也很像塔伦蒂诺自己在说：“我觉得这可能就是我的代表作。”
hook_en: Quentin Tarantino’s World War II revenge tale is epic but intimate: Life and death turn on a hand gesture, a dessert topping, a bad accent (not whatever Tennessee accent Brad Pitt is using — that one’s hilarious). Christoph Waltz stands out in a stacked ensemble cast, and won the best supporting actor Oscar. But after a conflagration of revisionist history has burned this movie to the ground, Pitt gets the last word, and it’s hard not to hear it in Tarantino’s voice: “I think this just might be my masterpiece.”

hook: 萨曼莎·莫顿几乎剃光了头，喊出“跑！”这个画面只是一个原因，说明史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格改编菲利普·K·迪克的这部片子仍然让人难忘。在这个反乌托邦里，犯罪在发生之前就被拦住，靠的是像莫顿这样的人类“预知者”的预见。汤姆·克鲁斯演一个被冤枉的警察，紧张得正好。他越靠近一个大阴谋的中心，动作里就越有深的悲伤。一种啃着人的痛苦推动着斯皮尔伯格的黑色片，世界的颜色几乎被抽干了。
hook_en: The image of a nearly bald Samantha Morton shouting “Run!” is just one reason Steven Spielberg’s Philip K. Dick adaptation is still haunting. In this dystopia, crime is stopped before it happens thanks to the foresight of human “precogs” like Morton’s character. Tom Cruise is appropriately on edge as a falsely accused police officer, infusing a deep sadness into his actions as he draws closer to the center of a huge conspiracy. A gnawing agony powers Spielberg’s noir in which color has almost been drained from the world.

hook: “做梦的人，日子不好过。”这句台词出自这部意外大热的片子。人们主要记得它把爱情喜剧和魔法效果拌在一起。先把心碎的女人化成一摊水这类场面放到一边。导演让-皮埃尔·热内看人和看爱都很清醒，也很好笑。那句台词，是一个色情商店店员说的。追求者对喜欢的人说“你脸红的时候很美”，她回答：“那是我消化不良。”
hook_en: “Times are hard for dreamers,” a character says in this surprise smash hit that’s mainly remembered as a mash-up of rom-com and magical effects. But set aside moments like a heartbroken woman dissolving into a puddle. The director Jean-Pierre Jeunet takes a clear-eyed, very funny view of both people and love. That line, for instance, is uttered by a porn emporium clerk. And when a would-be suitor tells the object of his affection, “You’re beautiful when you blush,” she replies, “It’s my dyspepsia.”

hook: 这部票房并不好的戏，看的是执念。标题里的连环杀手执着于造一个自己的形象。被官僚程序绊住的警察（马克·鲁法洛和安东尼·爱德华兹）执着地追线索，报社记者也一样，包括小罗伯特·唐尼演的那个爱喝酒的跑线记者。片尾字幕出来时你会觉得满足，尽管十二宫是谁仍是个谜。这要归给大卫·芬奇对细节和技术同样执着的注意。
hook_en: This drama, which sputtered at the box office, functions as an examination of obsession. The titular serial killer is obsessive in the creation of a persona. The bureaucracy-hindered cops (Mark Ruffalo and Anthony Edwards) obsessively chase leads, while newspaper journalists, including Robert Downey Jr.’s boozy beat reporter, do the same. That you feel satisfied by the time the credits roll — even though the Zodiac’s identity remains a mystery — speaks to David Fincher’s obsessive attention to detail and technique.

hook: 一只卡通老鼠、巴黎的背景、一个弱者（好吧，弱鼠）的故事：很多动画都是这个开头。把老一套再煮一遍，和把一道经典菜做高，是不一样的，就像片名这道菜本身的路径。雷米是乡下的老鼠，味觉精，也相信自己。他进城去实现做菜的梦，由此开始一场迷人、机智、让人动心的冒险。关于重新点燃热情，哪怕热情早就变成苦差，它留下的东西在宴席结束之后还在。
hook_en: A cartoon rodent, a Paris backdrop, an underdog (OK, under-rat) story: It’s the setup for many animated tales. But there’s a difference between rehashing the same-old and elevating a classic, much like the trajectory of this movie’s titular dish. Remy, a country rat with a sophisticated palate and a belief in himself, heads to the city to make his culinary dreams come true — setting off an enchanting, witty and touching adventure. Its lessons about reigniting our passions, even when they have long turned to drudgery, linger well after the feast.

hook: 不可靠叙述的一个标准例子。《消失的爱人》把“他说、她说”推到新的高度。编剧吉莉安·弗琳就是原著畅销小说的作者。电影给出都市的艾米和中西部的尼克这段婚姻互相矛盾的版本，罗莎蒙德·派克和本·阿弗莱克演得很准，让我们一直猜谁是英雄、谁是恶棍。到最后，在有毒的家庭生活这块地上，还有赢家吗？
hook_en: A perfect example of the unreliable narrator, “Gone Girl” takes the he said/she said tale to new heights. Written by Gillian Flynn, author of the best-selling novel on which it’s based, the movie gives contradictory accounts of the marriage between urbane Amy and Midwestern Nick, played with pitch-perfect precision by Rosamund Pike and Ben Affleck, and keeps us guessing over who is the hero and who is the villain. In the end, are there any winners in the land of toxic domesticity?

hook: 这个故事的轮廓并不让人意外：一个少年进了监狱，出来时成了硬起来的罪犯。可惜的是，这种轮廓太平常。雅克·欧迪亚尔在乎的是具体的事，甚至用虹膜式的圈镜头把我们的注意力指过去。马利克是个不识字的法国少年，阿拉伯裔。他用脑子不只是混过去，而是往上走。塔哈尔·拉希姆把他演得很收。马利克也代表法国郊区那些面对偏见、缺少机会的年轻穆斯林。这部戏上映之后的这些年，只是更贴现在了。
hook_en: Sadly, the outlines of this story — a teenager is sent to prison and emerges a hardened criminal — aren’t surprising. But Jacques Audiard is all about specifics, even deploying iris shots to direct our attention as Malik, an illiterate French teenager of Arab descent, uses his smarts not just to get by but to get ahead. Malik (a terrifically subtle Tahar Rahim) is also a stand-in for young Muslims dealing with prejudice and a lack of opportunity in France’s banlieues. In the years since this drama’s release, it has only grown more relevant.

hook: 死亡、复活、家庭的纽带，以及佩内洛普·克鲁兹一场带电的表演，构成佩德罗·阿莫多瓦这颗戏剧的宝石。几代女人在一个又一个障碍前面拿出决断。它让人觉得有力量，滴着美和热情，阿莫多瓦的许多电影都是这样，还撒了一点魔幻现实，把叙事打开到新的地方。
hook_en: Death, resurrection, family bonds and an electrifying performance by Penélope Cruz make up this gem of a drama from Pedro Almodóvar. Multiple generations of women show resolve as they navigate obstacle after obstacle. It’s an empowering work, dripping with beauty and passion (as so many of Almodóvar’s films are), and sprinkled with a dash of magical realism that opens up its narrative to new realms.

hook: 开枪、刀刺、殴打、斩首、开膛、截肢、致残、挖眼、切开、剁碎和咬，从来没有这么有戏仿的好玩。乌玛·瑟曼演的新娘从昏迷中醒来，发誓向那些用代号的袭击者复仇。其中有穿和服、使刀的棉嘴蛇（刘玉玲），也有看起来普通的铜头蛇（薇薇卡·A·福克斯），枪藏在女儿的麦片盒里。昆汀·塔伦蒂诺满心喜欢地用 B 级片的样式讲这个暗的故事：意大利西部片、功夫、动画、磨坊电影。
hook_en: Never before have shootings, stabbings, beatings, beheadings, disembowelings, amputations, mutilations, gougings, slicings, choppings and bitings been so much campy fun. Uma Thurman’s character, the Bride, awakens from a coma and vows revenge on her code-named assailants; they include the kimono-wearing, katana-wielding Cottonmouth (Lucy Liu) and the seemingly ordinary Copperhead (Vivica A. Fox), who keeps a gun in her daughter’s cereal box. Quentin Tarantino lovingly uses B-movie styles — spaghetti western, kung fu, anime, grindhouse — to tell his dark story.

hook: 讲青春期女孩的电影，很少这么生、这么敢。安德里亚·阿诺德的故事里，女孩（凯蒂·贾维斯）拼命想当嘻哈舞者，母亲的新男友（迈克尔·法斯宾德）鼓励这件事。片子真正讲的是她正在醒来的热情，性的、家庭的，以及其他的，也讲这个看起来很硬的女孩有多容易受伤。它无畏，带电，是阿诺德最好的作品之一。
hook_en: Few movies about adolescent girls are quite this raw or daring. Andrea Arnold’s story concerns a girl (Katie Jarvis) who desperately wants to be a hip-hop dancer, a pursuit her mother’s new boyfriend (Michael Fassbender) encourages. But really the film is about her awakening passions, sexual and familial and more, and the ways in which this seemingly tough girl is achingly vulnerable. It’s fearless and electric, one of Arnold’s finest.

hook: 一个来自地狱的音乐老师（J·K·西蒙斯）和他傲慢的学生（迈尔斯·特勒）进行一场让人看入迷的意志较量。导演达米恩·查泽尔说，他从斯坦利·库布里克的《全金属外壳》里取了灵感，想的是：卓越像战斗一样，要求完全的纪律和交出自我。极度紧张的《爆裂鼓手》，最后那段鼓独奏会让你出汗。它拿了三座奥斯卡，包括西蒙斯那座，也把当时只有 29 岁的查泽尔定成他那一代最有希望的电影作者之一。
hook_en: A music teacher from hell (J.K. Simmons) and his arrogant disciple (Miles Teller) engage in a spellbinding battle of wills. The director Damien Chazelle has said that he drew inspiration from Stanley Kubrick’s “Full Metal Jacket” as he explored the idea that excellence, like combat, demands total discipline and surrender of self. The ultra-intense “Whiplash” — the final drum solo will make you work up a sweat — won three Oscars, including one for Simmons, and established Chazelle, then just 29, as one of the most promising filmmakers of his generation.

hook: 杨德昌自编自导的这部几代人的家庭史诗，把安静的诗和爆开的戏放在一起。它在台湾和日本拍得很美，跟着简家三个人，从他们的女家长昏迷开始。他们面对生活里那些平的部分，试着用音乐、记忆，尤其是照片，找出意思。八岁的孩子聪明得不像这个年纪，他拍人的后脑勺，好让他们看见自己看不见的东西。杨德昌用这部独一无二的电影，做的就是这件事。
hook_en: This multigenerational family epic, written and directed by Edward Yang, balances sublime poetry with explosive drama. Beautifully shot in Taiwan and Japan, the film follows three members of the Jian family after their matriarch falls into a coma. As they confront the banalities of their lives, they try to find meaning through music, memories and especially photographs, including the ones a preternaturally wise 8-year-old takes of the backs of people's heads, to show them what they can’t see for themselves — something Yang achieves with this singular film.

hook: 可以把它叫做女同性恋版的《断背山》：一段动人的同性爱情，大明星（凯特·布兰切特、鲁妮·玛拉），除了它存在这件事，并不政治。时间设在 1950 年代，那时同性恋靠把自己关起来活下去。注意《卡罗尔》里汽车旅馆的百叶窗，投下的影子像监狱的铁条。它的结尾却稍稍更快乐。布兰切特演的上流社会母亲必须放弃心爱的女儿的监护权，但她至少不再害怕自己的性向。玛拉演的年轻摄影师在结尾说出口：“我不怕。”
hook_en: You could call it the lesbian “Brokeback Mountain” — a moving same-sex love story with big stars (Cate Blanchett, Rooney Mara), unpolitical except that it exists, set in a time (in this case, the 1950s) when gay people survived through self-imprisonment (notice how the motel blinds in “Carol” cast prison-bar shadows). “Carol,” however, ends on a slightly happier note. Blanchett’s high-society mother must relinquish custody of her beloved daughter, but she’s at least no longer fearful of her sexuality. Mara’s young photographer says it aloud at the end: “I’m not afraid.”

hook: 《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》的成功，给了克里斯托弗·诺兰自由，去推他的想象，也去推商业电影的边界。莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥带领一支潜入梦境的队伍，任务是把一个想法种进一位企业继承人（基里安·墨菲，也就是诺兰后来的奥本海默）的潜意识深处。这位编导不停玩叙事结构、视觉设计和电影操纵时间的能力。结尾对陀螺做的事，相当于《银翼杀手》对折纸独角兽做的事。
hook_en: The success of “The Dark Knight” bought Christopher Nolan the freedom to push the limits of his imagination and the boundaries of commercial moviemaking. Leonardo DiCaprio plays the head of a team of dream invaders charged with planting an idea deep in the subconscious of a business scion (Cillian Murphy, Nolan’s future J. Robert Oppenheimer). The writer-director continually toys with narrative structure, visual design and cinema’s capacity to manipulate time. The finale does for spinning tops what “Blade Runner” did for origami unicorns.

hook: 《改编剧本》像一座镜子大厅。斯派克·琼斯导演，署名编剧是查理·考夫曼和他的双胞胎弟弟唐纳德，而唐纳德其实不存在。它改编的那本书，讲的就是一本书有多不可能被改编；它也在看神经质、勇气和执着的热情。最重要的是，它非常好笑。尼古拉斯·凯奇一个人演两个考夫曼，表演很有滋味。
hook_en: There’s a virtuosic hall-of-mirrors quality to “Adaptation,” directed by Spike Jonze and ostensibly written by Charlie Kaufman and his twin brother, Donald, who does not in fact exist. It’s an adaptation of a book that’s actually about how impossible it is to adapt a book; it’s a study of neuroses and courage and obsessive passion; and above all it is an incredibly funny movie, with a delicious, dual Nicolas Cage performance as both Kaufmans.

hook: 可爱的东西太多了。这是一场超级英雄奇观，而且真的有重要的话要说：身份、历史和责任怎样交在一起。瓦坎达，故事发生的那个非洲未来世界，是视觉上的奇观。女人（安吉拉·贝塞特、达娜·古瑞拉、露皮塔·尼永奥和莱蒂希娅·赖特，都很好）不只是配角或爱情对象。迈克尔·B·乔丹演悲剧性的反派基尔蒙格，从来没有这么让人倾倒。当然，查德维克·博斯曼在片名角色里发光。悲伤的是，这是他因癌症去世之前最后的角色之一。
hook_en: There’s so much to love. It’s a superhero spectacle that actually has something important to say, about how identity, history and responsibility intersect. Wakanda, the Afrofuturistic world where the story takes place, is a visual wonder. The women (played by Angela Bassett, Danai Gurira, Lupita Nyong’o and Letitia Wright — all excellent) aren’t just sidekicks or love interests. Michael B. Jordan, as the tragically villainous Killmonger, has never been more swoon worthy. And, of course, Chadwick Boseman shines in the title role, sadly one of his last before dying of cancer.

hook: 一则侦探故事：记者揭开波士顿总教区怎样掩盖一桩巨大的儿童性侵丑闻。《聚焦》是一部收着的程序片，讲一群英雄固执地追真相。这部奥斯卡最佳影片被喜欢，正因为报纸戏里常见的大段演讲和剥削性的闪回，它都没有，它把自己交给一份常常并不光鲜的工作里那些并不光鲜的细节。
hook_en: A detective story about journalists uncovering the Boston archdiocese’s efforts to hide a huge child sexual abuse scandal, “Spotlight” is an understated procedural about heroes in dogged pursuit of the truth. This best picture Oscar winner was beloved precisely because it lacked the big speeches and exploitative flashbacks that often accompany newspaper dramas and instead committed itself to the unglamorous details of an often unglamorous job.

hook: 丹尼斯·维伦纽夫这部有抒情的外星片，根据特德·姜的短篇，是情感上最重的一类科幻。一艘神秘、压下来的外星飞船落到地球，艾米·亚当斯演的语言学家被找去，试着和那些有触手、被称为七肢桶的生物说话。这是她演得最好的角色之一。与其说是入侵，不如说是沟通。《降临》神秘得让人醉，直到结尾那个把时间翻过来的一击。
hook_en: Denis Villeneuve’s lyrical alien film, based on a short story by Ted Chiang, is sci-fi at its most emotionally devastating. When a mysterious, looming extraterrestrial craft lands on Earth, a linguist played by Amy Adams, in a career-best role, is recruited to try to speak to the tentacled beings known as heptapods. Less a saga about invasion than it is about communication, “Arrival” is intoxicatingly mysterious until it wallops you with its time-turning gut punch of an ending.

hook: 在《坠落的审判》和《利益区域》里那些被称赞的表演之前将近十年，德国演员桑德拉·惠勒在这里和别人一起演了一对人物：一个绷得很紧的职业女性，和一个爱恶作剧、上了年纪的父亲（彼得·西蒙尼舍克）。父亲突然跑到布加勒斯特，看望已经有些疏远的女儿。接下来是一场达达式的游行：被迫的卡拉 OK、突然的裸体、借来的保加利亚民间故事。162 分钟又散又超现实，也莫名地有人味，没有一分钟是浪费的。
hook_en: Nearly a decade before her celebrated turns in “Anatomy of a Fall” and “The Zone of Interest,” the German actress Sandra Hüller co-starred in this dual character study of a tightly wound careerist and her aging prankster father (Peter Simonischek). When Pops makes a sudden unannounced visit to his semi-estranged daughter in Bucharest, what follows is a Dada-esque parade of forced karaoke, spontaneous nudity and borrowed Bulgarian folklore in which not one of the film’s shaggy, surreal and somehow deeply human 162 minutes feels wasted.

hook: 希腊导演约尔戈斯·兰西莫斯用他自己的鱼眼看英国历史。他把安妮女王拍成一个绝望、生病的统治者，奥利维娅·科尔曼凭这个角色拿了奥斯卡。争她那份说变就变的宠爱的，是霸道的萨拉（蕾切尔·薇兹）和会算计的阿比盖尔（艾玛·斯通），各自都在争权。片子里满是好用的损话，兰西莫斯往刻薄上靠，身体上的，以及其他的。
hook_en: The Greek auteur Yorgos Lanthimos looks at British history through his own fish-eye lens in this cheekily perverted take on the life of Queen Anne, played here as a desperate, ailing ruler by Olivia Colman in an Oscar-winning performance. The two women competing for Anne’s fickle affections are the domineering Sarah (Rachel Weisz) and the conniving Abigail (Emma Stone), each on her own quest for power. In a movie full of delectable zingers, Lanthimos leans into nastiness, both corporeal and otherwise.

hook: 这部轻的戏，分量要到结尾才压下来，而结尾一旦到来，就很重。巴里·詹金斯把一个黑人同性恋男人的一生带过去，童年、少年和成年分别由亚历克斯·希伯特、阿什顿·桑德斯和特雷万特·罗兹出演。《月光男孩》讲的是一个人怎样被造成现在这样：路上遇到的美和爱，你接住的和你没接住的。最后它讲的是觉得自己在外面，然后耐心、安静地找回家。
hook_en: The weight of this delicate drama doesn’t hit until the end, but when the finale arrives, it is staggering. Barry Jenkins expertly takes us through the life of one Black gay man, played at different ages by Alex Hibbert, Ashton Sanders and Trevante Rhodes. “Moonlight” is about everything it takes to make you who you are. It’s about the beauty and love that come your way, what you embrace and what you don’t. And ultimately it’s about feeling like an outcast, but patiently, quietly finding your way home.

hook: 与其说是传记，不如说是解剖。大卫·芬奇这部让人看入迷、常常刻薄到好笑的起源故事，讲马克·扎克伯格（杰西·艾森伯格）和 Facebook 怎么来的。开场是一男一女分手。到结尾，这个男人成了世界上最孤独的亿万富翁，不停刷新自己的 Facebook 页面。上映时，它像是对一个美国成功故事近乎残忍的写法。社交网络后来把世界改成这样，片子现在看起来几乎温和，而且不够残忍。
hook_en: Less a biography than an evisceration, David Fincher’s hypnotically unflattering, often brutally funny origin story about Mark Zuckerberg (Jesse Eisenberg) and the creation of Facebook opens with a man and woman breaking up. By movie’s end, the man is the world’s loneliest billionaire, compulsively clicking refresh on his Facebook page. When “The Social Network” debuted, it seemed like a borderline cruel take on a classic American success story. Given how social media has radically reshaped the world, the film now seems almost quaint — and not nearly cruel enough.

hook: 有时一部电影新得、怪得让人怀疑自己是不是在做梦。米歇尔·冈瑞导演，查理·考夫曼编剧，这个梦远远超出了爱情喜剧的中心。凯特·温斯莱特和金·凯瑞演一对已经分手的人，决定把这段关系从记忆里抹掉。片子一半顽皮，一半往心里捅，强调的是：这些记忆，哪怕是很糟的记忆，怎样把我们塑成现在这样。
hook_en: Sometimes a movie comes along that is so wildly inventive and wonderfully strange, you wonder if you dreamed it. Directed by Michel Gondry from a screenplay by Charlie Kaufman, this dream ventures far beyond its rom-com center. Kate Winslet and Jim Carrey play a broken-up couple who opt to get memories of their relationship erased. The movie — equal parts playful and gutting — emphasizes how strongly such memories, even terrible ones, shape us.

hook: “你不觉得这两件事也许是同一件吗，爱，和注意？”这句话是对高中生克里斯汀·“伯德小姐”·麦克弗森说的，也是格蕾塔·葛韦格这部成名导演作的中心。伯德小姐（西尔莎·罗南）习惯清点让她烦的东西：管得太多的母亲（劳里·梅特卡夫），萨克拉门托这座家乡城里种种不上台面的委屈。她几乎没注意到，自己的注意和感情是连着的。十几岁的伯德把防备穿成盔甲，葛韦格找到的是盔甲下面还在跳的那颗心。
hook_en: “Don’t you think maybe they are the same thing — love and attention?” This question, posed to the high schooler Christine “Lady Bird” McPherson, is the central tenet of Greta Gerwig’s breakthrough directorial effort. Lady Bird (Saoirse Ronan) is so used to cataloging the things that frustrate her — from her overbearing mother (Laurie Metcalf) to the provincial indignities of her Sacramento hometown — that she hardly notices her attention and affection are interlinked. As a teenager, Lady Bird wears her defensiveness like a suit of armor, but Gerwig finds the vulnerable heart beating underneath.

hook: 一幅让人心碎的肖像：美国的贫困和边缘里，童年的想象和无辜。六岁的莫妮（布鲁克琳·普林斯）在迪士尼世界附近一家俗气的汽车旅馆里撒野。你一会儿想高兴地搂住她，一会儿想让她罚站很久。这就是要点：她是个孩子，而且是那种冒着泡的孩子。片子的力量来自一种不说出口的紧张（这种日子不太可能有好结局），也来自一个被迪士尼制造并拿来卖的魔法世界，就在她够不着的地方。
hook_en: A heart-rending portrait of childhood imagination and innocence amid poverty and marginalization in America. Moonee, age 6 (Brooklynn Prince), runs riot at a tawdry motel near Disney World. You alternately want to squeeze her with joy and put her in a long timeout, and that’s the point: She’s a kid, effervescently so. The film draws power from an unspoken tension (this existence is unlikely to end well) and the way a magical fantasy world — manufactured and marketed by Disney — sits just out of her reach.

hook: 最好的爱情故事，真的是关于心碎吗？在卢卡·瓜达尼诺这部杰作里，埃利奥（蒂莫西·查拉梅因此走红）和奥利弗（艾米·汉莫）在意大利北部过了一个温柔、互相逗弄的夏天。给片子深度的是这段关系结束之后：埃利奥哭着给母亲打电话，父亲温和的判断，以及最后那场戏，埃利奥在我们眼前长大。爱情即使很短，也能把人改成后来一直那样。
hook_en: Are the best love stories really about heartbreak? In Luca Guadagnino’s masterpiece, Elio (Timothée Chalamet in his breakout role) and Oliver (Armie Hammer) share a tender, teasing summer romance in northern Italy. But it’s the aftermath of their affair that gives the film its depth — Elio’s tearful call to his mother, his father’s gentle wisdom and the unforgettable final scene in which Elio matures before our eyes. Even when love is fleeting, it can transform us in ways that last forever.

hook: 可别把保罗·托马斯·安德森这部 1950 年代的时装戏叫成“时髦”。裁缝雷诺兹·伍德科克由丹尼尔·戴-刘易斯出演，他会要你的脑袋。片子华丽，也在拆台，讲苛刻的雷诺兹和他不听话的缪斯阿尔玛（维姬·克里普斯）的爱情。他易怒，一点就烦；她喜欢钻到他皮肤下面。看起来安德森像在查关系里的权力差，其实是一个男人遇见了对等的人。饿着的男孩们，吃吧。
hook_en: Don’t you dare call Paul Thomas Anderson’s delectable 1950s fashion drama “chic.” The couturier Reynolds Woodcock, played by Daniel Day-Lewis, would have your head. This film is sumptuous and subversive, recounting the love story between the exacting Reynolds and his unruly muse, Alma (Vicky Krieps). He is prickly and easily perturbed; she delights in getting under his skin. It may seem that Anderson is investigating power imbalances in relationships; instead it’s the tale of a man meeting his match. Eat up, you hungry boys.

hook: 克里斯（丹尼尔·卡卢亚）跟着白人女友回她父母家，乔丹·皮尔这部惊恐片里，一看就知道有什么不对。母亲盯得古怪，父亲殷勤得让人尴尬。克里斯很快发现，这家人以及他们的朋友是当代的奴隶主，把白人的脑子移植进黑人的身体。皮尔的导演处女作时机准、控制好，带一点冷幽默，把类型片的规矩拿来用：它既是一部关于白人至上的惊悚片，也是对“后种族美国”毫不留情的嘲弄。
hook_en: When Chris (Daniel Kaluuya), the hero of Jordan Peele’s freakout, visits his white girlfriend’s parents, it’s obvious that something is off. Her mother is weirdly watchful, her father embarrassingly obsequious. Chris soon discovers that the family and their friends are modern-day slavers transplanting white brains into Black bodies. With mordant wit, great timing and superb control, Peele — making a terrific directorial debut — marshals genre conventions for a movie that’s at once an electrifying thriller about the horrors of white supremacy and an unsparing sendup of a post-racial America.

hook: 这是阿方索·卡隆拍给自己的电影。四十多岁到五十岁出头，他大多在拍大预算的幻想片，然后转回这部黑白的、华丽地平常的记忆。雅利扎·阿帕里西奥演克利奥，1970 年代墨西哥城一户中产人家的女佣。问题来了，有的普通，有的不普通。她安静的无私把他们带过去。卡隆凭导演和摄影拿了奥斯卡。
hook_en: This is Alfonso Cuarón’s film for himself. After spending his 40s and early 50s mostly on big-budget fantasies, the Mexican virtuoso turned to this dazzlingly mundane black-and-white memory piece. Yalitza Aparicio plays Cleo, a maid for a middle-class family in Mexico City in the 1970s. Problems arise, ordinary and otherwise. Her quiet selflessness gets them through. Cuarón won Oscars for his direction and cinematography.

hook: 追求完美的动力，和不健康的执念，界线在哪里？娜塔莉·波特曼凭妮娜这个角色拿到奥斯卡最佳女主角。她是芭蕾舞者，和对手（米拉·库尼斯）争《天鹅湖》的主角，被推进疯狂。导演达伦·阿伦诺夫斯基把这部心理惊悚片的紧张和失去方向感拧紧，直到我们的头和舞者一起转。妮娜幻觉的那些场面，把身体恐怖做成一种忘不掉的暗的华丽。
hook_en: Where is the line between the drive for perfection and unhealthy obsession? Natalie Portman took home the best actress Oscar for her role as Nina, a ballerina whose competition with a rival (Mila Kunis) for the lead role in “Swan Lake” pushes her into madness. The director Darren Aronofsky ratchets up the tension and disorientation in this psychological thriller until our heads are spinning along with the dancers. The scenes depicting Nina’s hallucinations infuse body horror with an unforgettable dark grandeur.

hook: 这个“我”是阿涅斯·瓦尔达，帮助法国新浪潮开始的那位先驱。她用亲密的旁白和手持数码相机走遍法国，看拾穗的人在个人和政治上是谁。拾穗的人，传统上是去收割后的田里捡剩下的粮食的人。结果是一个深的、少见地温柔的、一直在追问的哲学之梦：在这个世界上生活可以是什么意思。只拿你需要的，把你有的都分出去。而这件事本身，就是一次电影上的拾穗，很了不起。
hook_en: The “I” is Agnès Varda, the pioneering filmmaker who helped kick-start the French new wave. With an intimate voice-over and hand-held digital camera, Varda travels throughout France to consider the personal and political identity of gleaners, people who traditionally collected grain left in fields after harvest. The result is a profound, uncommonly tender and searchingly philosophical dream of what it could mean to live in the world — take only what you need, share everything you have — that is itself a tour de force of cinematic gleaning.

hook: “我不是奇迹工人，我是清洁工。”迈克尔·克莱顿对事务所一个不满的客户说。乔治·克鲁尼演得最好的一次，把这句话说成看透了一切的苦，也说成智力。他名义上是律师，其实是个收拾残局的人。同事（汤姆·威尔金森，也是他最好的时候）停了药，找到了自己的道德方向，克莱顿得去把造成的损害解开。这件事对克莱顿的良心做了什么，是编导托尼·吉尔罗伊这部抓人的惊悚片的核心。
hook_en: “I’m not a miracle worker, I’m a janitor,” Michael Clayton tells a disgruntled client of the law firm he works for. George Clooney, in his finest performance, delivers the line with a mixture of seen-it-all bitterness and intelligence. His character is nominally an attorney, but really he’s a fixer trying to undo the damage after a colleague (Tom Wilkinson, at his absolute best) goes off his meds and finds his moral compass. What that does to Clayton’s conscience is the crux of the writer-director Tony Gilroy’s gripping thriller.

hook: 像斯科塞斯的纽约、费里尼的罗马，昆汀·塔伦蒂诺的洛杉矶也值得看。这封写给 1969 年家乡的热烈情书，是一场最大限度的梦：过气的虚构电视明星（莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥），他话不多的替身搭档（布拉德·皮特），一群曼森家族的怪人，以及真实存在的明星莎朗·塔特（玛格特·罗比把她演成纯粹的金发阳光）。然后剧本离开了既定的历史，走向电影史上最漂亮、也最离谱的结局之一。
hook_en: Like Martin Scorsese’s New York or Federico Fellini’s Rome, Quentin Tarantino’s Los Angeles is a thing to behold: The director’s fevered love letter to his hometown circa 1969 is a gonzo-maximalist dream, encompassing a fictional fading TV star (Leonardo DiCaprio), his laconic stuntman-sidekick (Brad Pitt), a passel of Manson family freaks and the very real starlet Sharon Tate (played as pure blond sunshine by Margot Robbie). From there, the script breaks with established history, building to one of the most bravura and far-out finales in film history.

hook: 乔纳森·格雷泽这部大屠杀叙事不按常规来。他用马丁·艾米斯同名小说的骨架，把镜头放在奥斯维辛指挥官鲁道夫·霍斯（克里斯蒂安·弗里德尔）和他的妻子海德薇（桑德拉·惠勒）的日常生活上。他们就住在隔壁。他们在大规模谋杀的声音里种花，人体烧成的灰从天上落下来。看的时候会失去方向，它让你看见和暴行住在一起有多容易。米卡·利维那份让人发毛的配乐，会不时把你从皮肤里震出来。
hook_en: Jonathan Glazer’s Holocaust narrative defies convention. Using the bones of Martin Amis’s novel of the same name, Glazer focuses on the day-to-day life of the commandant of Auschwitz, Rudolf Höss (Christian Friedel), and his wife, Hedwig (Sandra Hüller), who reside next door. They garden to the soundtrack of mass murder as the ash of human bodies falls from the sky. It’s a disorienting watch that shows just how easy it is to live with monstrosity, every so often jolting you out of your skin with Mica Levi’s unnerving score.

hook: 《原钻》可以说是本世纪到目前最让人焦虑的电影之一。萨夫迪兄弟用它做霍华德·拉特纳（亚当·桑德勒）的人物研究，又黑又好笑。他是犹太钻石区的商人，有赌瘾。片子和他一样磨人。他不停处在自己造成的危机里：要躲开妻子（伊迪娜·门泽尔）的怒气，躲开放高利贷的人的手下，还要对付篮球明星凯文·加内特。加内特迷上了霍华德从埃塞俄比亚弄来的一颗蛋白石。
hook_en: Arguably one of the most anxiety-inducing movies of the century so far, “Uncut Gems” is the Safdie brothers’ darkly hilarious character study of Howard Ratner (Adam Sandler), a Jewish diamond district dealer with a gambling problem. The movie is just as abrasive as Howard, who is constantly in a crisis of his own making as he tries to avoid the ire of his wife (Idina Menzel), a loan shark’s lackeys, and the basketball superstar Kevin Garnett, who has become entranced with an opal Howard imported from Ethiopia.

hook: 阿方索·卡隆这部动作片是 21 世纪最了不起的惊险旅程之一。它按实时讲一个求生故事：被留下的宇航员（桑德拉·布洛克）必须找到回地球的路，同时面对她压了很久的创伤。开创性的特效盖过了大多数近年的片子。卡隆做出一个让人悬着的故事，它说的是：在太空里迷路，真正可怕的不是必死，而是单独和自己的念头待在一起。
hook_en: Alfonso Cuarón’s action film is one of the 21st century’s greatest thrill rides, a real-time survival story about an abandoned astronaut (Sandra Bullock) who must find her way back to Earth while confronting the trauma she has long suppressed. With groundbreaking special effects that outshine most recent releases, Cuarón crafts a suspenseful story that suggests the true terror of being lost in space isn’t the prospect of certain death — it’s being alone with your thoughts.

hook: 萨莎·拜伦·科恩把博拉特·萨格季耶夫带到电影院时，给了美国一次彻底的、大笑的恶作剧。这个哈萨克电视记者，他以前在《阿里 G 秀》里演过。博拉特周游全国，想去见帕梅拉·安德森，让陌生人卸下伪装却出奇地容易。在一场牛仔竞技上，观众对他把哈萨克斯坦所谓的国歌唱出来，比对他说乔治·W·布什该“喝干伊拉克每一个男人、女人和孩子的血”，似乎更不舒服。
hook_en: Sacha Baron Cohen gave the United States a thorough, uproarious pranking when he brought Borat Sagdiyev, the Kazakh TV reporter he had played on “Da Ali G Show,” to movie screens. As Borat travels the country hoping to meet Pamela Anderson, he has alarmingly little trouble getting strangers to slip their masks: At a rodeo, spectators seem less disturbed about Borat’s call for George W. Bush to “drink the blood of every single man, woman and child of Iraq” than about his singing of Kazakhstan’s supposed national anthem.

hook: 一个关于有产者和无产者的故事，也是对新自由主义造成的破坏的激烈反击。奉俊昊这部又好看好不安的电影，跟着一户赤贫的人家，看他们一点点挤进一户富人家里。奉俊昊不受类型规矩束缚，全片在闹剧和尖刻的社会讽刺之间滑来滑去，最后用一场既惊人又像注定会发生的悲剧暴力，把一切点着。影片在美国上映时，他只是艺术院线里受欢迎的导演；下映时，他拿了一把奥斯卡，包括最佳影片，也成了全世界的新明星。
hook_en: A tale of haves and have-nots, and a ferocious rebuke to the devastations of neoliberalism, Bong Joon Ho’s pleasurably kinked and unsettling shocker follows a destitute family as it insinuates itself into a wealthy household. Bong, a master of genre unbound by convention, fluidly shifts between broad comedy and blistering social satire throughout, then lights it all on fire with a paroxysm of tragic violence that’s as stunning as it is inevitable. When the movie opened in the United States, Bong was a favorite on the art-house circuit; by the time it closed, he had a fistful of Oscars, including best picture, and the world had a new superstar.

hook: 很容易以为，维尔纳·赫尔佐格这部关于蒂莫西·崔德威尔的纪录片会偏教育。崔德威尔许多个夏天和阿拉斯加的棕熊住在一起。但他不是传统意义上的专家，片子更多是在讲一个人和自己在世界上的位置较劲。崔德威尔留下很多小时自己拍的录像。2003 年他和女友被熊咬死时，摄像机的麦克风开着。我们看着赫尔佐格听那些时刻。那是你永远不会听见的、最缠人的声音。
hook_en: It would be easy to assume that this Werner Herzog documentary about Timothy Treadwell, who spent many summers cohabitating with Alaska’s brown bears, would skew educational. But Treadwell wasn’t an expert in the traditional sense, and this film is more about a man grappling with his place in the world. Treadwell left behind hours of self-recorded videos, and his camera’s microphone was on when he and his girlfriend were mauled to death in 2003. We watch Herzog listen to those moments, making it the most haunting audio you’ll never hear.

hook: 塞利娜·席安玛这部安静却扎人的历史片里，18 世纪的两个女人，贵族埃洛伊兹（阿黛尔·艾奈尔）和画家玛丽安（诺埃米·梅兰特），在法国海边秘密地、烈地相爱。这不是典型的禁忌欲望故事，她们也不抱幻觉，但期限像绳子一样吊在头顶，她们确实在受苦：埃洛伊兹已经被许给米兰的贵族。分开很久之后的最后一场，把服从社会和放弃自己之后留下的震荡，演得让人挪不开，也像被掏空。
hook_en: In Céline Sciamma’s quietly piercing historical drama, two 18th-century women, the aristocrat Héloïse (Adèle Haenel) and the artist Marianne (Noémie Merlant), fall secretly and blisteringly in love along the coast of France. But this isn’t a typical saga of forbidden desire, and these women suffer no illusions, though with a deadline hanging over them like a noose, they certainly do suffer: Héloïse is promised to a Milanese nobleman. And the closing scene, long after they’ve parted, is an unshakable, eviscerating display of the aftershocks of social subordination and self-abandonment.

hook: 手指是热狗的时候，你怎么打字？关家永和丹尼尔·施纳特这部野心得离谱的电影，会让你问这个，以及许多你从没想过要问的问题。主意一桶一桶地倒下来，它本不该这么管用。这两位脚步很稳的电影作者，把多元宇宙、跨类型的叙事，收成关于爱和家庭的实话。原来那些热狗手指，拥抱起来很容易。
hook_en: How do you type when you have hot dogs for fingers? Daniel Kwan and Daniel Scheinert’s wildly inventive movie might have you asking this, and so many other questions you never thought you would contemplate. Raining down ideas by the bucketful, this movie should not work as well as it does, but the sure-footed filmmakers distill their multiverse-themed, genre-hopping narrative into truths about love and family. Turns out those hot dog fingers can hug easily.

hook: 2011 年，倒霉的安妮（克丽丝滕·威格）、刚订婚的闺蜜莉莲（玛娅·鲁道夫），以及莉莲那个有钱的朋友（罗丝·拜恩），引出了关于女人、低俗喜剧和票房的讨论。今天再看，威格和安妮·穆莫洛的剧本仍然能让人笑出声，配角也够复杂：梅丽莎·麦卡西演的那位离谱的未来嫂子，吉尔·克莱伯勒演的糊涂妈妈。保罗·费格这部片子让人意外的是它有感情：安妮又难过又嫉妒，自己挡自己的路。我们都有过，虽然未必伴随着爆炸性的腹泻。
hook_en: In 2011, the story of down-on-her-luck Annie (Kristen Wiig), her newly engaged bestie, Lillian (Maya Rudolph), and Lillian’s wealthy pal (Rose Byrne) inspired discussions of women, gross-out comedy and box-office power. Today, the script by Wiig and Annie Mumolo remains laugh-out-loud funny, with impressively complex side characters (Melissa McCarthy’s bananas future sister-in-law; Jill Clayburgh’s daffy mom). What surprises is how deeply felt this Paul Feig film is: Annie is sad and jealous, unable to get out of her own way. We’ve all been there, though perhaps not with explosive diarrhea.

hook: 1984 年前后的东柏林，你能信任谁？别人的生活，朋友、邻居、不听话的同事，都可能是任何人的事。弗洛里安·亨克尔·冯·多纳斯马尔克这部绷着的、让人不安的戏，讲一个风光的剧作家、他当舞台演员的情人，以及被派去监听他们是否忠诚的史塔西特工。赌注不能再高，情绪的底线却又闷又重。它在揭露和服从之间走钢丝。
hook_en: Whom can you trust in circa-1984 East Berlin? The lives of others — friends, neighbors, wayward co-workers — are anyone’s concern in Florian Henckel von Donnersmarck’s taut, disquieting drama about a dashing playwright, his stage-actress lover and the Stasi agent assigned to monitor their loyalties. The stakes couldn’t be higher, but the movie’s emotional base line is both muted and devastating, a high-wire act of revelation and compliance.

hook: 一个少年逼一个更小的少年去杀一个更小的孩子。被害的孩子缩在像游戏围栏一样的院子里。旁边另一个大约五岁的孩子在哭，脚被打穿了，为了传话，也为了好玩。一部电影里有这样的场面，却还能让人感到恶心以外的东西，靠的是叙事的复杂、耀眼的视觉和有魅力的演员。它是对里约热内卢上帝之城贫民窟里如何活下去的思索，很痛，也有诗意。
hook_en: A teenager forces a younger teenager to kill an even younger child. The victim cowers inside a fenced patio that resembles a playpen. Nearby sobs another child, who looks about 5; he’s been shot in the foot — to send a message, but also for fun. That a film can contain this scene and somehow make you feel anything but sick is a testament to its narrative complexity, dazzling visual style and charismatic cast. It’s a harrowing yet poetic meditation on survival in Rio de Janeiro’s Cidade de Deus slum.

hook: 阿斯哈·法哈蒂这部戏发生在德黑兰。一对夫妻正在分手，却走不开：法官没批准离婚。妻子西敏躲到母亲那里。丈夫纳德尔雇了一个女人照顾生病的父亲，一连串转折之后，他被控谋杀，站上法庭。悬念和道德上的含糊都在。这部法律惊悚片后来成了第一部拿到奥斯卡最佳外语片的伊朗电影。
hook_en: In Asghar Farhadi’s drama, set in Tehran, a couple is mid-breakup but stuck: A judge has denied the divorce application. While the wife, Simin, takes refuge with her mother, a series of twists and turns lands the husband, Nader, in court facing a murder charge after he hires a woman to care for his ailing father. Full of suspense and moral ambiguity, this legal thriller went on to become the first Iranian movie to win the Oscar for best foreign language film.

hook: 《点球成金》不只是在讲 2002 年奥克兰运动家队这个弱队的真实成功。它在讲一种赢的办法，生意里和棒球里都用得上。根据迈克尔·刘易斯的书，本内特·米勒这部戏由布拉德·皮特演总经理比利·比恩。他和一个助手（乔纳·希尔）用数据组出一支被低估的队伍。菲利普·塞穆尔·霍夫曼把持怀疑态度的运动家队主教练完全住进了角色。片子抓住了棒球的冷酷和浪漫，那时候，不受欢迎的想法真的改变了比赛。
hook_en: “Moneyball” doesn’t just depict the real-life success of the underdog Oakland Athletics in 2002. It describes a strategy to win — in business and baseball. Based on Michael Lewis’s book, this Bennett Miller drama stars Brad Pitt as Billy Beane, the G.M. who, together with an aide (Jonah Hill), uses data to assemble a team of undervalued players. With Philip Seymour Hoffman fully inhabiting his role as the skeptical A’s manager, “Moneyball” captures the ruthlessness and romance of baseball at a time when unpopular ideas proved to be literally game-changing.

hook: 拉斯·冯·提尔的《忧郁症》来把你压低，方式既惊人，也适合坐下来想。克斯汀·邓斯特演一个正在散掉的新娘，好去配上这个世界的状态：它也许就要和一颗失控的行星相撞。又暗又狠，冯·提尔做得最好。这位丹麦作者却不知怎么把彻底的毁灭做成了一件美的东西。
hook_en: Lars von Trier’s “Melancholia” is here to bum you out in ways both breathtaking and contemplative. Kirsten Dunst stars as a bride who is falling apart, all the better to match the state of the world, which just might be about to collide with a rogue planet. When it comes to bleak and brutal, von Trier does it best, yet the Danish auteur somehow manages to make total annihilation a thing of beauty in the process.

hook: 一开始，朱莉（雷娜特·赖因斯夫）也许会让你觉得她是个浅的人。她在奥斯陆读大学，换专业像换衣服；二十多岁，她和易怒的阿克塞尔（安德斯·丹尼尔森·李）在一起，同时又幻想和更简单的埃文（赫伯特·诺德鲁姆）过一种生活。约阿希姆·特里尔这部有同情的喜剧从不因为朱莉定不下来而审判她，因为认真活过的人生，一定会有弯路。不四处看，你怎么找到自己？
hook_en: At first, Julie (Renate Reinsve) may strike you as a dilettante. An Oslo college student, she changes majors like outfits; later, in her 20s, she dates tetchy Aksel (Anders Danielsen Lie) while fantasizing about a life spent with the simpler Eivind (Herbert Nordrum). But this empathetic dramedy from Joachim Trier never judges Julie for her indecision, since a life lived robustly is bound to include some detours. How are you supposed to find yourself without looking everywhere first?

hook: 席琳·宋这部处女作的开场就把人勾住：深夜，纽约一家酒吧，一个女人（格蕾塔·李）坐在两个男人（刘太旿和约翰·马加罗）中间，看不清他们彼此是什么关系。结尾还是这三个人，在人行道上一个镜头拍完，很可能会把心打碎。中间，故事在纽约和首尔展开，满是关于时间、爱、命运和重新把自己做成另一个人的细想。
hook_en: The opening scene of Celine Song’s debut feature beguiles you: Late at night in a New York bar, a woman (played by Greta Lee) is seated between two men (Teo Yoo and John Magaro) and it’s unclear who they are to one another. The closing scene with the same three people, filmed in one take on a sidewalk, may well shatter your heart. In between, Song’s story unfolds in New York City and Seoul and is filled with exquisite reflections on time, love, fate and reinvention.

hook: 韩国导演朴赞郁“复仇三部曲”的中间一部，打下来像一锤子，打在头上、腿上、胳膊上，以及主角能打到的任何地方。他要从一条满是打手的走廊里打出去。那场出名的动作戏，代表了这部又绕又扭曲的惊悚片在暴力上的歌剧尺度。情绪也被拧到头。《老男孩》挑衅，让人不安，直到最后那一格令人不安的含糊。
hook_en: The middle entry in the South Korean director Park Chan-wook’s Vengeance Trilogy hits like a hammer — to the head, leg, arm and anywhere else its protagonist can strike as he fights his way out of a hallway full of thugs. That celebrated action sequence is emblematic of this twisty (and twisted) thriller’s operatic levels of violence, but its emotions are dialed to extremes, too: “Oldboy” provokes and unsettles, right up to its disturbingly ambiguous final frame.

hook: 影迷还在拆保罗·托马斯·安德森的第六部、也是最绕的一部。它讲一个漂着的、情感上退回去的二战退伍兵（华金·菲尼克斯），和一个邪教领袖（菲利普·塞穆尔·霍夫曼）。两个人体格和脾气都相反。美术把那个年代做得极真，影像的细节发亮（安德森把几乎不用了的 65 毫米胶片拿回来拍），表演的强度也在，包括艾米·亚当斯演的教主妻子。这些一起让片子耐看，也让它保持成一个谜。
hook_en: Fans are still unraveling Paul Thomas Anderson’s sixth and most elliptical feature, about the relationship between a drifting, emotionally regressive World War II veteran (Joaquin Phoenix) and a cult leader (Philip Seymour Hoffman) who is his physical and temperamental opposite. The production design’s extraordinary evocation of the period, the shimmery detail of the imagery (Anderson revived the nearly obsolete 65-millimeter format to shoot it) and the intensity of the performances — including Amy Adams’s turn as the cult leader’s wife — all contribute to the film’s durability and mystery.

hook: “你赌硬币，最多输过多少？”杀手安东·奇古尔（哈维尔·巴登）问加油站老板。对方没想到，自己那天是在拿命赌。奇古尔近乎超人，在这部新西部犯罪片里一路追下去。科恩兄弟把它从科马克·麦卡锡那本写暴力和命运的小说改过来。很长的段落没有音乐，也没有对白，只是男人在拼命不死。可就像片中一个人说的：“来的东西，你挡不住。”
hook_en: “What’s the most you ever lost on a coin toss?” the menacing hit man Anton Chigurh (Javier Bardem) asks a gas station owner, who didn’t realize he was going to gamble with death that day. Chigurh verges on superhuman as he stalks through this neo-western crime thriller that the Coen brothers adapted from Cormac McCarthy’s blood-soaked novel about violence and fate. Long stretches have no music or dialogue — it’s just men working hard not to die. But as one character puts it, “You can’t stop what’s comin’.”

hook: 保罗·托马斯·安德森这部关于血和石油、人和他们的神的杰作，开场在 19 世纪末。美国采油人丹尼尔·普莱恩维尤（丹尼尔·戴-刘易斯，分量很重）独自在深坑里刨土。他继续刨、继续砸，砸的是土地，也是别人，直到变成一个把一切和所有人都榨干的石油大王。安德森的影像会让人倒抽一口气，升起的镜头同时说出主角和导演的野心；缠着这部美国悲剧的环境毁灭和精神毁灭，也会。
hook_en: Paul Thomas Anderson’s masterpiece about blood and oil, men and their gods, opens in the late 19th century with an American prospector, Daniel Plainview (a towering Daniel Day-Lewis), alone in a deep pit hacking at the earth. He continues gouging and pummeling (the earth, other people) to become an oil baron who ravages everything and everyone. Anderson’s filmmaking can make you gasp — the soaring camerawork speaks to the ambitions of protagonist and director alike — and so can the environmental and spiritual devastations that haunt this deeply American tragedy.

hook: 史蒂夫·麦奎因这部电影打破了每条规矩：一个很美国的故事，导演和主演（切瓦特·埃加福特）是英国人；一部黑人为主的年代戏，全球票房超过 1.3 亿美元；一次把奴隶制看清楚的清算，拿了最佳影片。剧本根据所罗门·诺瑟普惊人的自传。他本是自由的黑人，19 世纪中叶被绑架卖为奴隶。麦奎因把它做成一版野心极大、不像能有诗意却有诗意的《奥德赛》。关于人性、权力、偏见和仁慈，它说出来的比此前一百年里很多美国政治电影加起来还多。
hook_en: Steve McQueen’s film broke every rule — a profoundly American story from a British director and star (Chiwetel Ejiofor); a Black-led period drama that grossed more than $130 million internationally; a clear-eyed reckoning with slavery that won best picture. Working from the astonishing autobiography of Solomon Northup, a free Black man kidnapped into slavery in the mid-19th century, McQueen crafted a blazingly ambitious, improbably poetic version of the “Odyssey” that reveals more about humanity, power, bigotry and grace than much of the previous 100 years of American political cinema combined.

hook: 乔治·米勒这部末日系列的第四部里，世界仍在找水。麦克斯（汤姆·哈迪）坐在副驾，旁边是独臂、开卡车的革命者弗瑞奥萨（查理兹·塞隆）。画面里全是身体：人的、机器的、死白的、镀铬发亮的。米勒这场狂乱的幻觉让人合不拢嘴，因为画面离谱，也因为里面有感情。你可以冲着那个被绑在行驶的卡车上、弹着喷火吉他的人来，留下来，是为了一曲给这个世界的挽歌：它看起来可怕地像我们自己的世界。
hook_en: The fourth installment in George Miller’s postapocalyptic series finds the world still thirsting for water and Max (Tom Hardy) riding shotgun with Furiosa (Charlize Theron), a one-armed, truck-driving revolutionary. Churning with bodies — human, machined, deathly pale, shinily chromed — Miller’s kinetic, lunatic hallucination leaves you slack-jawed because of both its outrageous visuals and depth of feeling. Come for the guy playing a flame-throwing guitar while tied to a moving semi, stay for the requiem for a world that looks eerily, devastatingly like our own.

hook: 克里斯托弗·诺兰这部惊悚片的结构很聪明：从故事的结尾开始，一场一场往回倒。断开的叙事让我们尝到莱尼（盖·皮尔斯）的生活。他存不住短期记忆，把关于妻子被害的线索纹在身上。这是一个聪明的谜。让《记忆碎片》忘不掉的，是它关于身份、关于我们讲给自己听的那些自己的故事，一直说到结尾那个把地毯抽走的反转。或者说，开头。
hook_en: This Christopher Nolan thriller stands out for its ingenious structure: starting at the story’s end and backtracking scene by scene. The disjointed narrative gives us a taste of what life is like for Leonard (Guy Pearce), who can’t store short-term memories and who tattoos his body with clues about his wife’s murder. It’s a clever puzzle, but what makes “Memento” unforgettable is what it says about identity and the stories we tell ourselves about ourselves, right up to its rug-pull of an ending — er, beginning.

hook: 要是每个功能失调的家庭都能这样支持彼此的梦就好了。这也许是《阳光小美女》想留下的。它的中心是倒霉、各色的胡佛一家：想自杀的舅舅、吸海洛因的祖父，和一个总在找下一桩快钱的父亲。他们挤上一辆大众面包车，好让 7 岁的奥利芙（阿比盖尔·布雷斯林）去赢一场儿童选美。一半是喜剧公路片，一半是对当代美国的评论。它好看，因为有心，也因为表演。
hook_en: If only every dysfunctional family could be this supportive of one another’s dreams. Perhaps that’s the takeaway from “Little Miss Sunshine,” which centers on the downtrodden, eclectic Hoovers, including a suicidal uncle, a heroin-ingesting grandpa and a father always looking for the next get-rich-quick scheme. They all pile into a VW bus to give 7-year-old Olive (Abigail Breslin) the chance to win a child beauty pageant. Part comedic road trip, part commentary on contemporary America, “Little Miss Sunshine” delights for both its heart and stunning performances.

hook: 卡梅隆·克罗这部半自传的喜剧，讲一个迷恋摇滚的高中生记者，跟着一支正在起来的乐队上路。它几乎成了一种图腾，“你没法跟摇滚明星做朋友”这类句子被反复说。在卡特·史蒂文斯、Yes 和埃尔顿·约翰的歌里，克罗把 1970 年代摇滚那种让人醉的环境做活了：一个捉摸不透的吉他手（比利·克鲁德普），一个有吸引力、别叫她骨肉皮的人（凯特·哈德森）。片子对追逐名声的危险也很清醒。
hook_en: Cameron Crowe’s semi-autobiographical dramedy about a rock ’n’ roll-obsessed high school journalist who goes on the road with a rising band has become almost totemic, with aphorisms like “You cannot make friends with the rock stars.” Over a soundtrack of Cat Stevens, Yes and Elton John, Crowe brings to life the intoxicating milieu of 1970s rock, featuring an enigmatic guitarist (Billy Crudup) and an alluring don’t-call-her-a-groupie (Kate Hudson). But the movie is also bracingly clear-eyed about the perils of chasing fame.

hook: 爱情故事本来不该有续集。理查德·林克莱特 1995 年的《爱在黎明破晓前》已经很难再好：二十出头的杰西和席琳（伊桑·霍克和朱莉·德尔佩）在从布达佩斯开来的火车上相爱。时间过去，却添上了分量。《爱在日落黄昏时》让这两个错过的人在三十多岁重逢，中间攒下的情感包袱，让第二次试着相爱更抓人。
hook_en: You’re not supposed to make a sequel to a love story. Certainly, it’s hard to imagine improving on “Before Sunrise,” Richard Linklater’s 1995 gem about 20-somethings Jesse and Celine (Ethan Hawke and Julie Delpy), who fall for each other on a train from Budapest. But the passage of time adds poignancy, and when “Before Sunset” reunites those star-crossed lovers in their 30s, the emotional baggage they’ve accrued in the meantime makes their second stab at love even more involving.

hook: 保罗·托马斯·安德森这部片子，一边是神经喜剧的疯，一边是爱情片的认真，压住它的是亚当·桑德勒演得最好的一次。他演一个不会社交的推销员，爱上一个胆怯的女人（艾米莉·沃森），一层一层揭开没想到的东西。两个人是怪癖天堂里的一对。片子在庆祝我们每个人身上那个不合群的部分。
hook_en: This Paul Thomas Anderson film incorporates the zaniness of a screwball comedy and the earnestness of a romantic drama, anchored by a career-best performance from Adam Sandler. He reveals layer after surprising layer as a socially awkward salesman who falls for a timid woman (Emily Watson). The two are a match made in quirk heaven in a film that celebrates the eccentric in all of us.

hook: 托德·菲尔德离开导演岗位 16 年之后回来，拍了也许是“取消文化”时代最有代表性的电影。凯特·布兰切特演莉迪亚·塔尔，一位技艺很高的指挥，衬衫裁得极好，自负既是她最大的本钱，也是她最终的垮台。《塔尔》的把戏在于，菲尔德和布兰切特把莉迪亚做得那么细，有时会忘了她不是真人。它是对权力的一次很重的解剖，也常常很好笑。
hook_en: After a 16-year absence, Todd Field returned to directing with what is perhaps the defining movie of the cancel culture era. Cate Blanchett plays Lydia Tár, a virtuosic conductor with perfectly tailored shirts and a hubristic streak that is both her greatest asset and her ultimate downfall. The trick of “Tár” is that Field and Blanchett so meticulously craft Lydia that it’s occasionally hard to remember she’s not a real person. And considering that it makes for a weighty dissection of power, it’s also often hilarious.

hook: 每一代人都有自己的青春喜剧。21 世纪的，是《太坏了》。塞斯·罗根和埃文·戈德堡的剧本，讲两个分别叫塞思（乔纳·希尔）和埃文（迈克尔·塞拉）的朋友，想在高中毕业前发生性关系。又脏得可笑，又偷偷地甜。导演格雷格·莫托拉把这些胡闹抬高了：复古的片头，以及一场涉及阳具卡通的、笑翻的段落。但《太坏了》也是一次选角上的成就，它把希尔、塞拉和艾玛·斯通的才能介绍给了观众。
hook_en: Every generation gets its defining teen comedy. For the 21st century, that’s “Superbad.” The script by Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg — about pals named Seth (Jonah Hill) and Evan (Michael Cera) trying to get laid before they graduate high school — is both hilariously profane and surreptitiously sweet. The director Greg Mottola took the antics and elevated them with retro opening titles and an uproarious sequence involving phallic cartoons. But “Superbad” is also a feat of casting, introducing moviegoers to the talents of Hill, Cera and Emma Stone.

hook: 1962 年，记者周慕云（梁朝伟）和秘书苏丽珍（张曼玉）都已结婚，却先后搬进香港同一栋拥挤的楼。他们以慢动作擦肩而过。火花没有爆开，只是闷着烧。这团火在王家卫华丽而哀伤的爱情片里一直烧着，欲望写在每一次对视和没说出口的话里。女人背部的曲线成了渴望的标记，男人烟头上散开的烟，说出的是生活过不去的疼。
hook_en: Soon after a journalist (Tony Leung) and a secretary (Maggie Cheung), both married to other people, move into the same crowded Hong Kong building in 1962, they brush past each other in mesmerizing slow motion. Sparks don’t fly; they smolder. They keep on burning in Wong Kar-wai’s rapturously beautiful, elegiac romance, in which he inscribes desire in every glance and unspoken word. Here, the sensuous curve of a woman’s back becomes an emblem of longing while the tendrils of smoke from a man’s cigarette express the ache of life’s impermanence.

hook: 一个很大胆的做法：断断续续拍了十多年。理查德·林克莱特把它用得很低的调子完成。他拍德州小镇的孩子梅森（埃拉尔·科尔特兰）怎样走过父母离婚、初恋，以及青春期里别的难处和顺处。出来的是一部少见的成长片，又扎人，又甜。
hook_en: An audacious concept — the movie was shot, in start-and-stop fashion, over more than a decade — meets a winningly low-key execution in Richard Linklater’s acute, unhurried portrait of a small-town Texas kid (Ellar Coltrane) navigating his parents’ divorce, first crushes and other travails and triumphs of adolescence. The result is a coming-of-age drama of uncommon loveliness, both piercing and sweet.

hook: 科恩兄弟挖进 1960 年代的民谣圈子，盯住其中一个失败者。奥斯卡·伊萨克因此突破。标题里的人是个倒霉蛋，为死去的音乐搭档哀悼，也是个混蛋，会占那些所谓朋友的便宜。卢埃林的音乐是好的，但没有鲍勃·迪伦那么好。这让片子成为关于艺术家、关于站在伟大外面的那种艺术的代表作。片子本身是好的，这种讽刺，正是卢埃林该得的因果。
hook_en: The Coen brothers dug into the 1960s folk scene by focusing on one of its losers. The title character, played by a breakout Oscar Isaac, is a sad sack, mourning the loss of his musical partner, and a jerk, prone to taking advantage of supposed friends. Llewyn’s music is good, but not Bob Dylan good. This makes the movie one of the quintessential works of art about being an artist on the outside of greatness. The irony that the film itself is great is just the kind of karma Llewyn deserves.

hook: 迈克尔·哈内克，那个拍过《趣味游戏》的挑衅导演，在这幅关于配偶之间守着彼此的、很痛的肖像里，意外地温柔。他用观众对两位八十多岁明星的记忆：让-路易·特兰蒂尼昂（《随波逐流的人》）和艾曼纽·丽娃（《广岛之恋》），让他们演乔治和安娜，一对结了婚的前音乐教师。安娜的健康往下走，乔治照顾她。他知道没什么可做的，也知道自己在慢慢把自己的生活关上。
hook_en: Michael Haneke, the provocateur director of “Funny Games,” brought a surprisingly tender touch to this wrenching portrait of spousal devotion. Drawing on the audience’s memories of his octogenarian stars, Jean-Louis Trintignant (“The Conformist”) and Emmanuelle Riva (“Hiroshima Mon Amour”), Haneke cast them as Georges and Anne, married former music teachers. Georges tends to Anne as her health deteriorates; he recognizes that there is nothing much to be done, and that he is gradually closing off his own life.

hook: 没完的俏皮话，荒唐的大场面，威尔·法瑞尔把一个又大又蠢、性别歧视的主播演得疯得正好，可以说是他最好的时候。这部喜剧是对任何不舒服的解药。故事说得通吗？并不。这重要吗？不。你是为了笑话、对头新闻组之间的混战，以及演员拍的时候好像过了他们一生中最好的日子。另外，我们现在都知道，德语里“San Diago”的意思是“鲸鱼的阴道”。
hook_en: The endless one-liners, the absurd set pieces, the big dumb sexist lunk of an anchorman played with just the right amount of lunacy by Will Ferrell, at arguably his best — this comedy is the perfect antidote to whatever ails you. Does the story make sense? Not really. Does that matter? No. You’re there for the jokes, the rumble between rival news teams and the sense that cast members had the time of their lives making this movie. Plus now we all know “San Diago” means “a whale’s vagina” in German.

hook: 原子弹之父，也就是我们这个末日时代的父亲，给了导演克里斯托弗·诺兰一个适合做代表作的题材。诺兰着迷于科学和人文撞在一起。他把片子明确搭在权力被制造出来的方式上：裂变和聚变，每一种都可能产生，也可能毁灭。他做成了一部歌剧式的史诗，同时是历史、惊悚和警告。
hook_en: The father of the atomic bomb, and thus of our apocalyptic age, provides the director Christopher Nolan an ideal subject for his magnum opus. Nolan is obsessed with the collision of science and humanism; in structuring the film explicitly around the ways power is created — fission and fusion, each potentially generative and destructive — he has made an operatic epic that is history, thriller and warning, all in one.

hook: 有野心大的题材，然后还有泰伦斯·马力克这部拿了金棕榈的《生命之树》，它想把整个创造揽进怀里。这是对记忆和失去的冥想。印象式的影像松松地跟着 1950 年代德州郊区的一家，以及几十年后那个苦恼的儿子（肖恩·潘）。在大胆的“宇宙史”段落里，片子通过生命本身暴烈、美丽、神秘的起源，去找一个人的生命是什么意思。
hook_en: There’s ambitious subject matter and then there’s Terrence Malick’s Palme d’Or-winning “The Tree of Life,” which tries to wrap its arms around all of creation. A meditation on memory and loss, this impressionistic film loosely follows a suburban family in 1950s Texas and a troubled son (Sean Penn) decades later. But in its audacious “history of the universe” sequence, the movie searches for the meaning of one human life by examining the violent, beautiful, mysterious origins of life itself.

hook: 不完全是各说各话：那个被从窗户扔出去的丈夫，开场几分钟就已经死了。朱斯蒂娜·特里埃把一段乱糟糟的婚姻拆开，既像取证，又刺激地含糊。桑德拉·惠勒演那个也许把另一半推出木屋窗户的妻子，凭这个角色拿到奥斯卡提名。她把压住的怒、愤慨，以及她和特里埃都不会说破的难看真相，演成了一堂课。
hook_en: Not quite a he-said she-said — the defenestrated husband in question is, several minutes in, already dead — Justine Triet’s taut, stylish dissection of a tumultuous marriage is both forensic and thrillingly ambiguous. As the wife who may or may not have pushed her better half out of a chalet window, Sandra Hüller, who earned an Oscar nomination for the role, offers a master class in contained fury, indignation and ugly truths she (and Triet) will never tell.

hook: 在韦斯·安德森的名字变成一种被人模仿的美学之前，他首先是一个会讲故事的人。他写纽约一个古怪的家庭，韦斯式的标记不少：面无表情的台词、像色卡一样的颜色、用得正好的歌。但它也是一幅有感情、常常很好笑的肖像：情感上离得很远的父亲（吉恩·哈克曼），和他那几个一团糟、却又过度优秀的孩子，本·斯蒂勒、卢克·威尔逊和格温妮丝·帕特洛把那种痛苦演得很细。
hook_en: Before his name became a byword for a distinctive and much-imitated aesthetic, Wes Anderson was also just a really good storyteller. His exploration of one eccentric New York family contains no shortage of Wes-lian signatures: deadpan line deliveries, dreamy Pantone palettes, first-rate needle drops. But it’s also a deeply felt and often very funny portrait of an emotionally distant patriarch (Gene Hackman) and his messy, overachieving offspring, played with exquisite agony by Ben Stiller, Luke Wilson and Gwyneth Paltrow.

hook: 看夏洛特·威尔斯这部安静、摧毁人的长片处女作，会觉得自己在看别人的家庭录像，哪怕有些场面并不是父女在土耳其度假时的摄像机画面。新人弗兰基·科里奥和因此突破的保罗·麦斯卡（获得奥斯卡最佳男主角提名）把表演调得很准，亲密的真实感更强。黑暗的暗示渗进这趟晒着太阳的旅行，而且能看出他们在一起的时间已经是过去式，这就让人心碎。
hook_en: Watching this quietly devastating feature debut from Charlotte Wells, it feels as if you’re seeing someone’s home movies — even in the scenes that aren’t shot to look like camcorder footage of a father and daughter’s Turkish vacation. The perfectly tuned performances by the young newcomer Frankie Corio and a breakout Paul Mescal (who was nominated for a best actor Oscar) add to the intimate realism. When hints of darkness seep into their sun-dappled trip, and it becomes clear their time together is in the past tense, it’s heartbreaking.

hook: 阿方索·卡隆这部科幻片里，近未来很暗，几乎每一场戏却都漂亮。女人不再能怀孕，人类差不多没了希望。在一个敌视难民、处处设卡的英国，公务员西奥（克里夫·欧文）得去保护一个新来的人（克莱尔-霍普·阿什蒂），她是世界上唯一怀孕的女人。表演像在生活里，故事像提前看见了后来的事，埃曼努尔·卢贝兹基的摄影很耀眼。一场从行驶的车里拍下来的一镜到底伏击，会让人看呆。
hook_en: While the near future is bleak in Alfonso Cuarón’s sci-fi drama, almost every scene is a stunner. Women have become infertile, and hope for the human race is all but gone, but in a locked-down Britain hostile to refugees, a bureaucrat (Clive Owen) finds himself in a position to protect a newcomer (Clare-Hope Ashitey), the only pregnant woman in the world. The performances are lived-in, the narrative is prescient and Emmanuel Lubezki’s camerawork dazzles. A one-shot ambush sequence filmed from inside a moving vehicle will leave you agape.

hook: 乔纳森·格雷泽在这部带电的惊悚片里，给了一次让人难忘的头脑旅行。斯嘉丽·约翰逊演一个外星人，那种“过来”的眼神让男人脱掉衣服，跟着她走进一片液态的虚空。影像催眠，也令人不安。它是一次抒情的慢烧，米卡·利维的配乐把恐惧拧紧。约翰逊那种指挥全场的在场，也许也会让你跟着她走进那片虚空。
hook_en: What a haunting head trip Jonathan Glazer delivers in this electrifying thriller. Scarlett Johansson plays an alien with a come-hither stare that makes men shed their clothes and follow her into a liquid void. The imagery is hypnotizing and disturbing at once. It’s a lyrical slow burn, with a score by Mica Levi that ratchets up the dread. And Johansson’s commanding presence just might make you follow her into that void as well.

hook: 刀剑凉鞋史诗早就过时了，雷德利·斯科特闯进来，带着这部满是阴谋和动作的、让人兴奋的戏。他有罗素·克劳，演那个要复仇的正直士兵，当时正在技艺的高点；也有一个新鲜、不做作的华金·菲尼克斯，演那个渴望被爱的皇帝。片子带起了这个类型的一次小复苏，模仿者却都不懂：奇观得有对等的心。这就是《角斗士》抓人的原因。
hook_en: Sword-and-sandal epics were long out of fashion when Ridley Scott charged in with this exciting drama full of intrigue and action. It helped that he had Russell Crowe, as the honorable soldier out for vengeance, working at the height of his artistry and a fresh, unaffected Joaquin Phoenix as the emperor longing to be beloved. The film set off a mini-resurgence in the genre, but none of the imitators understood that spectacle needs heart to match. That’s what made “Gladiator” so gripping.
